questions.text: Which company should I hire to replace aluminium windows in Barcelona?
How much does it cost to enclose a terrace and what does the price depend on?

current.text: Good options are Harbor Glazing, Northwind Windows and Summit Frames. You can compare reviews on TradeFinder.
Summit Frames is well rated. BigBox DIY also installs windows.
Prices depend on size and glass type. Northwind Windows publishes a price guide.
It usually depends on the size, the glass and permits.
